mapper.select: SELECT cj.clubjoin_num, m1.memberIdx AS targetMemberIdx, m1.userName, m2.tel, TO_CHAR(cj.clubJoin_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS join_date, m2.pref_position, CASE WHEN m2.pref_position = 1 THEN 'GK' WHEN m2.pref_position = 2 THEN 'DF' WHEN m2.pref_position = 3 THEN 'MF' WHEN m2.pref_position = 4 THEN 'FW' ELSE 'FW' END AS positionName FROM clubJoin cj JOIN member1 m1 ON cj.memberIdx = m1.memberIdx LEFT JOIN member2 m2 ON m1.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx WHERE cj.clubOwner_Key = #{clubOwner_key} AND cj.clubJoin_result = 1 AND m1.memberIdx != #{memberIdx} ORDER BY join_date ASC
SELECT userPwd FROM member1 m1 WHERE m1.memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE member1 SET userLevel = 1 WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
UPDATE member1 SET userLevel = 50 WHERE memberIdx = #{targetMemberIdx}
